headline: Does giving a camera wings dodge the FCC’s drone ban?
summary: HoverAir is attempting to circumvent an FCC drone ban with its new flying camera. The brand is known for unique drone features like folding flat or landing on water. The US government banned future foreign drones starting December 2025.

headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
summary: Nielsen will use data from wearable devices to improve viewership measurement. This initiative aims to enhance accuracy in the streaming era. Key data capturing enhancements are being rolled out ahead of the fall season.

headline: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summary: Google Gemini is launching a new dedicated student hub for the back-to-school season. The hub offers tools for research, flashcards, and practice quizzes. Study notebooks will support graphs, images, and test date integration.

headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked unboxing and setup videos for the Steam Frame. The videos briefly appeared on the ARM Steam client before being pulled. The Steam Frame is Valve's upcoming virtual-reality headset for game streaming.

headline: The X-Tech Executive Chair Aims to Upend Premium Models from Herman Miller, Steelcase at a Better Price
summary: The X-Tech Executive Chair aims to challenge premium competitors like Herman Miller and Steelcase. It seeks to offer similar quality at a more affordable price point. The article highlights a "battle" in the high-end office chair market.

headline: Ryan Reynolds Congratulates Christopher Nolan's the Odyssey for Surpassing Deadpool & Wolverine to Become Highest Grossing R-Rated Movie of All Time
summary: Ryan Reynolds congratulated Christopher Nolan on "The Odyssey" Box Office success. "The Odyssey" surpassed "Deadpool & Wolverine" as the highest-grossing R-rated film. Both films have held the R-rated box office record at different times.

headline: Save $75 Off the Nintendo Switch 2 Plus Up to $130 in Best Buy Credit When You Trade in a Switch Console
summary: Best Buy offers $75 off the Nintendo Switch 2 with a trade-in. Customers can get up to $130 in Best Buy credit by trading in a Switch console. This deal provides up to $205 in total savings, ahead of a September 1 price increase.

headline: Mail-Order Media Giant Columbia House Shutting Down After 71 Years
summary: Columbia House, the mail-order media giant, is officially shutting down. After 71 years of operation, the company will cease all new orders. This marks the end of an era for the iconic music and movie club.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK later this month
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are reportedly moving back to the UK this month. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled in a UK school. The children are set to begin school in September.

headline: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but is their UK return forever?
summary: Harry and Meghan's sudden return to the UK raises many questions. The decision's permanence for the Duke and Duchess is unclear. The Royal Family also faces implications from their unexpected move.

headline: Students wait for GCSE and BTec grades as app launches for 750 schools in England
summary: Students in England are awaiting their GCSE and BTec grades. A new app has launched for 750 schools to deliver results. Some pupils can access their grades on phones from 11:00 BST on Thursday.

headline: Russia unleashes missile strikes on Kyiv and nearby region, killing at least six
summary: Russia launched missile strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region. At least six people were killed in the overnight attacks. A children's hospital in Kyiv was damaged, according to Mayor Klitschko.
